support.assistBody: Tell us your budget and occasion. We’ll help you choose a better mix.

promiseCards.title: Clear payment
promiseCards.body: Pay the exact shown amount and keep your transaction reference for confirmation.

promiseCards.title: See it before dispatch
promiseCards.body: You’ll get a packing video of the finished hamper before it is sent.

promiseCards.title: Issue protection
promiseCards.body: Verified wrong, damaged or defective items are covered by our refund/replacement policy.

promiseCards.title: Track your order
promiseCards.body: Every order gets a Celebration ID so progress and shipping details stay easy to follow.

checkout.policyConsent: I agree to the order policy. This is a prepaid customized order. Change-of-mind returns do not apply to personalized/custom hampers. Verified wrong, damaged or defective item claims are covered as per the protection policy.

policy.title: Know the important details before you order.
policy.lead: Payment, customization, packing and issue-protection terms are shown clearly so you know what to expect.

cards.title: Payment
cards.body: Orders are prepaid. Payment is confirmed after the submitted UPI reference matches the received payment.

cards.title: Customized orders
cards.body: Personalized hampers are made to your instructions, so normal change-of-mind returns do not apply.

cards.title: Wrong / damaged / defective
cards.body: Eligible verified issues are covered by refund or replacement protection. Relevant proof may be required for review.

cards.title: Packing video
cards.body: A packing video is shared before dispatch so you can review the finished hamper.

cards.title: Product substitutions
cards.body: If a major substitution is needed because of stock, size or presentation constraints, we’ll ask you before making the change.

cards.title: Required delivery date
cards.body: Your selected date is treated as a requirement. Final feasibility depends on preparation time, pincode and courier serviceability.

seo.title: Celebration | Custom Gift Hampers
seo.description: Build personalized Celebration gift hampers for birthdays, anniversaries, festivals and special moments.

issues.title: Something wrong with your order?
issues.body: Report a wrong, damaged, defective or missing item here. Our team will review the issue and help with the eligible resolution.
issues.submitted: Issue received. Our team will review it.
